items.title: US soldier killed and one injured after Iranian attack in Iraq
items.description: The US military reports another death a day after two of its soldiers were killed in Jordan.

items.title: Boy, 13, dies during World Cup celebrations in Spain
items.description: Two other young people were injured after a fountain partially collapsed in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo.

items.title: Trump says US strikes hit Iran in 'honour' of American soldiers killed
items.description: Iran responded with attacks in Syria and Jordan, as two ships reportedly exploded in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Food delivery rider wins China's top literary prize
items.description: Wang Jibing is among blue-collar Chinese workers gaining wider attention for their literary works.

items.title: Norway opens new memorial for victims of 2011 massacre
items.description: The artwork in the capital Oslo was unveiled on Sunday ahead of the 15th anniversary of the attack.

items.title: JD Vance says wife Usha and son 'happy and healthy' after birth of fourth child
items.description: The couple welcomed their fourth child, Alec Neel Vance, on Sunday morning.

items.title: Utah firefighter and four family members killed in flash flooding
items.description: A husband, wife and their three sons died - meaning that only a daughter who did not join the outing is still alive.
